title: Do these 5 every day this week, even with everyone home
caption: Weekend workout at home with no equipment, even with everyone home: Air Squat, Doorframe Row, Glute Bridge, Wall Push-Up, Full Plank. Two rounds, about ten minutes, one patch of floor and one doorframe. Save this for the weekend.

overlays.text: Do these 5 every day this week, even with everyone home.

scenes.footer: Squat. The living room is enough.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width, sit down slowly, stand back up tall.

scenes.footer: Pull. Any doorframe in the house.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the doorframe, lean back, pull your chest to it.

scenes.footer: Hinge. One patch of floor, even beside the couch.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Push. One wall, and nobody has to move.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower your chest, push away.

scenes.footer: Core. Held still, while the house stays loud.

overlays.text: Full Plank. 30 seconds. Forearms down, legs long, hold one straight line.

scenes.footer: Nothing skipped. All five patterns: the weekend has a floor and a doorframe.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the five. About ten minutes, with everyone still home.
Which room will you train in?
